# Noto Sans KR

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanskr
Bundled file: composeApp/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/noto_sans_kr.ttf
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, [OFL.txt](OFL.txt).
The bundled font is a renamed derivative, Moa Sans Regular, merging Noto Sans KR and monochrome Noto Emoji at weight 400. It renders Korean and emoji on the Wasm canvas without an external font service. Rebuild using tools/build_font.py with the upstream variable TTF files. Both upstream OFL licenses are retained.
